newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bankgesellschaft interested in BHF - report.
newsitem.headline: Bankgesellschaft interested in BHF - report.

text.p: Germany's Berliner Zeitung will report on Saturday that Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG has identified Frankfurt-based BHF Bank AG as an institution whose business would complement its own activities.

The newspaper quoted Bankgesellschaft management board chairman Wolfgang Rupf as saying the board has discussed interest in BHF Bank although no talks have taken place with the bank or with BHF's major shareholders.
Rupf said BHF's customer business would be a particularly "interesting complement" to Bankgesellschaft's own business.
A copy of the article was obtained by Reuters in advance of its official publication.
Rupf also said there were other potential takeover candidates in Germany and Europe, recalling previous speculation that Bankgesellschaft Berlin might be interest in Frankfurt-based BFG-Bank.
Berliner Zeitung reported that Rupf had said the bank intended to expand its activities in Frankfurt by "this way or that way."
Rumours of a takeover were widespread in financial markets here on Friday and both banks denied that a takeover was in the works.

The Daily Boersen-Zeitung had earlier reported that Bankgesellschaft was interested in buying at least 75 percent of BHF-Bank and had held talks with major BHF-shareholders which include Allianz AG Holding and DG Bank.
Bankgesellschaft reported on Wednesday that it was in merger talks with regional bank NordLB.
